body.statement: Using \(t>\max U_0\), append the independent covariance block \(\begin{psmallmatrix}4t&2t\\2t&4t\end{psmallmatrix}\). Its two roots have the identical signature \(\{4t,3t\}\), disjoint from \(U_0\). Thus the original \(\textsc{K-Fiber}\) instance is nonempty if and only if the augmented instance has two distinct witnesses at budget \(K+2\); appending the block last preserves \(q_\pi\).
body.justification: This is a query-correct Gaussian transfer from decision to actual two-witness recovery rather than a raw dictionary analogy.
body.gap: YatoSeta2003 requires solution-preserving reductions; the equal-signature faithful block supplies that missing property for this direction only.
